ui.note: Document the browser connection requirement on opening or reloading, automatic and manual retries for transport failures, and continued offline editing in already-open tabs. HTTP session and startup refusals keep their existing behavior; no cached identity or offline startup is added.

release.noImpact: Prepare alpha.12 and Android code12 with the retained signing identity and unchanged protected documentation epoch. Document Linux x64 DEB/RPM/AppImage, Windows x64/ARM64 NSIS and separate Apple Silicon/Intel DMGs, bounded installer checks, development checksums and remaining signing and qualification limits. Android artifacts and the retained update identity stay unchanged. The Compose release archive now includes postgres-healthcheck.sh, which the bundled database already bind-mounts, and packaging refuses archives missing any bind-mounted script. Release steps, assets and documented procedures are unchanged. GitHub Actions pins move to upload-artifact 7.0.2, download-artifact 8.0.2 and the current CodeQL v4 commit. Release jobs, inputs, artifacts, signing and publication steps are unchanged.

configuration.note: Document the 32-character production authentication secret requirement, maintenance-only BETTER_AUTH_SECRET_NEXT rotation, and the required pre-existing writable filesystem attachment directory.

deployment.note: The all-in-one image pins zlib 1.3.2-r1 because Alpine removed r0 from its mirrors. Same zlib upstream version and package set; configuration, deployment steps and documented behavior are unchanged. Set the shipped Zero revalidation interval to 30 seconds and document the revocation window and upgrade behavior. Document database recovery and shutdown timing within the default container and pod grace periods. Document ordered startup, revision-aware Helm readiness, AIO ingress boundaries and cache-only recovery for failed initial synchronization. Document container-readable file secrets, atomic role initialization, missing-role health failures and safe recovery without widening application privileges. Complete operator setup and restore instructions, preserve runtime role restrictions, explain PostgreSQL compatibility and app origin requirements, and pass Zero publication/reset configuration. The Zero and all-in-one images rebuild Litestream v0.3.13 and v0.5.15 with Go 1.27.3 for CVE-2026-111943 and the v5 binary with klauspost/compress 1.18.7 for CVE-2026-63209. Same Litestream sources, version suffixes, binaries and backup formats; configuration, deployment steps and documented behavior are unchanged.

native.note: Document native export source labels and upload times, separate system save dialogs, retained prepared files after cancellation or save failure, and Saved only after a confirmed write. Document Android Back dismissal and navigation order, top-level exit, and background network teardown during Activity recreation. Document recovery-code downloads through account-bound native save operations on Android and desktop, retry after a failed write, and distinct Android connection diagnostics without relaxing certificate trust. Document localized keyring setup and retry, the Linux package recommendation, and account-bound fixed Settings browser handoffs on desktop and Android. Matching Settings routes preserve the destination through browser sign-in; older servers still open their normal application page. Document the desktop online-start requirement for cached data, retry after reconnection, retention of durably saved edits, and the remaining encrypted evidence and refusal-policy work in issue 1090. Android cached activation and native credential and trust checks are unchanged. Document the asynchronous five-second launcher wait, retryable spawn and non-zero exit failures, and successful handoff when a launcher remains running beyond the bound.

authentication.note: OAuth registration denials preserve their stable policy code through Better Auth callback redirects. Native browser sign-in retains the grant ID and displays the localized policy message. Document periodic stream revalidation after session revocation; HTTP authorization remains checked against live session state. Invitations remain HTTPS browser links with fragment tokens and backward-compatible acceptance; native task scheme handling is unchanged. Document the current account name, identity update validation, synced display behavior, and managed-account normalization with JSON validation errors. Production startup validates secret length and retained JWKS decryption. The authentication guide links the stopped-replica secret rotation procedure instead of direct replacement. Browser sign-in checks the per-IP ceiling before creating IP-plus-email buckets. The handoff and trusted-proxy guides document that order, unchanged limits and batch-drained cleanup; docs/security.md records the body bound and unchanged TOTP lockout.

compatibility.noImpact: Browser startup fetches distinguish transport rejection from received HTTP responses. No auth evidence, synced data, storage keys or persisted formats are added or changed.
compatibility.upgrade: Deploy the updated browser bundle and public shell; no schema or stored-data conversion is required.
compatibility.backup: The existing coordinated database, blob and secret backup procedure is unchanged.
compatibility.rollback: The previous bundle uses the same stored data and restores the prior generic startup or sign-in display during a network failure.
compatibility.clientVersions: Existing web and native clients remain compatible; native startup and credential policy are unchanged.
